Nederländerna 2026: försäljningsvinsten: Netherlands 2026: the sale gain is not taxed as capital income. The main home is subject to Box 1; eigenwoningforfait, interest deductions and bijleenregeling are excluded here. Second and rental homes belong in the January 1 Box 3 basis. Enter those values and debts in the owner’s external wealth information.
Nederländsk skattepliktig anställningsin: Dutch taxable employment income (fiscaal loon) below AOW age, with general and employment credits. Box 3 uses January 1 wealth, EUR 59,357 tax-free per person, 36% tax and 6% deemed return on investments. Savings and debt rates of 1.28% and 2.70% are preliminary 2026 assumptions; final values are set in 2027. Actual return (tegenbewijs), partner reallocation, Box 2 and green investment exemptions are unsupported. Ordinary savings interest may be cash flow as capital income but adds no income tax: the account value must be included in external Box 3 bank savings.
